from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d7e9b32c.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = None
    # The two images are separated by a uniform row or column.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r == h - r - 1:
            split = ("row", r)
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c == w - c - 1:
                split = ("col", c)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered uniform separator found")

    axis, cut = split
    if axis == "row":
        first, second = grid[:cut], grid[cut + 1:]
    else:
        first = [row[:cut] for row in grid]
        second = [row[cut + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(x for row in first for x in row) & set(x for row in second for x in row)
    if len(common) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one shared color, found {common}")
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(first[0]))] for r in range(len(first))]
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.read_text())
